description.value: Tamarind Tales is a fine-dining Indian restaurant on West Broadway in Vancouver, led by a head chef with over 20 years of experience in authentic Indian cooking. The menu spans street food and chaat, tandoori signatures, and full mains, with an all-you-can-eat buffet service and event space accommodating up to 120 guests. Touring cyclists will find a sit-down meal with broad vegetarian choices alongside a convenient online pickup option.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Indian restaurant at 1128 W Broadway #201, Vancouver with phone (+1) 778-666-6060 and email info@tamarindtales.ca; OSM address tags align with the website address. Takeout is confirmed by 'Order Online' and '15% Off Pick-up orders' on the homepage; multiple explicit vegetarian dishes (Veg Combo, Paneer wrap, Veg Pakora, Paneer Tikka, Samosa veg) confirm vegetarian options. No mention of bike parking, water refill, or washrooms was found on the website or in OSM tags; the /menu-1/ subpage contains apparent unfilled website-template content (Greek Salad, Spanish-language text, $349 prices) unrelated to the actual Indian menu.
concerns: Phone number (+1) 778-666-6060 confirmed on website but absent from OSM tags — OSM record should be updated.

The /menu-1/ subpage contains apparent unfilled website-template placeholder content (items such as 'Greek Salab', 'Tortilla Espanola', Spanish-language descriptions, and prices of $349) that do not belong to this Indian restaurant, suggesting an incompletely customized website template.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established Indian restaurant on a major Vancouver cycling corridor (West Broadway) with confirmed vegetarian options and takeout; a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple vegetarian items: Veg Combo (Dal Makhani or Channa Masala with rice and naan), Paneer wrap, Veg Pakora (mixed vegetable and paneer), Paneer Tikka, Samosa (veg), Papri Chaat, Pani Puri, Dahi Puri, Dahi Bhalla, Chilli Paneer
